title: Check optional distribution files through their opened descriptors
summary: The repository's optional distribution packer now binds filesystem-selected native sources and assets to their opened regular, single-link file identities, bounds reads by their observed size and the existing distribution file ceiling, and refuses changed descriptor, path or containment state before admitting bytes. Unchanged explicit selections retain their archive bytes, and already-selected asset buffers keep their existing behavior. The checks do not lock a mutable directory tree or authorize publication.
